name: @cc/dsh-tool-families
description: Gives each agent preset only the tool families its job needs: one host row expands a per-preset deny policy against the tool names the agent can see and calls agent.ctx.tools.restrict, so a family (mcp__godot__*, mcp__playwright__*) leaves the request header instead of being merely refused at call time. A project-gated family is a bridge, not a role capability, so it is kept only where its project marker exists.
